question: To what kind of person is a gift prescribed as to be given?
premises: A gift is prescribed as to be given.
It is to be given to one endowed with all states.
It is to be given to one of resolved mind.
inference: A gift is to be given to one endowed with all states and of resolved mind.
plain_english: It is to be given to one endowed with all states, to one of resolved mind.
